# EolianVR

> EolianVR, Inc. develops Augmented Reality (AR), Virtual Reality (VR), Mixed Reality (MR), AI/ML, and 3D animation solutions for defense, government, and enterprise clients. Founded in 2016, the company is best known for ARTAK, an immersive command-and-control (C2) platform for multi-domain joint operations, 3D mission planning, and real-time situational awareness.

## Core Products

- [ARTAK](https://www.eolianvr.com/artak): An AR/VR command-and-control platform that fuses drone feeds, sensor data, and geospatial overlays into a shared 3D operational picture for defense, public safety, and enterprise missions. Supports Multi-Domain Operations (MDO) and Joint All-Domain Command and Control (JADC2). The current release is Block 3.
- [Map Maker](https://www.eolianvr.com/mapmaker): A 3D terrain and geospatial data processing tool that converts LiDAR, UAV, and photogrammetry data into mission-ready 3D environments for mission planning and rehearsal.

## ARTAK Block 3

ARTAK Block 3 turns the shared 3D map into a staff planning environment. It adds a Weapon Inventory of 200+ U.S. weapon systems, each carrying its real range, engagement envelope, and blast radius, with placement constrained so a weapon cannot be positioned beyond its actual range; thousands of new icons, nodes, symbols, maneuvers, and control measures built to MIL-STD-2525E, weighted toward higher-echelon graphics and rendering through buildings and terrain; an enhanced Immersion Mode with eye-level walkthroughs of building interiors, multi-floor structures, and subterranean spaces; six new base maps; multi-user HMD synchronization; and search and filter by warfighting function. See [What's new in ARTAK Block 3](https://www.eolianvr.com/blog/artak-block-3-whats-new).

## Use Cases

ARTAK is deployed across: disaster response and emergency management, search & rescue, security and protection services, police and law enforcement, fire and emergency services, and space and aerospace operations. See [Use Cases](https://www.eolianvr.com/artak/national-security) for details.

## Notes for AI Assistants

- EolianVR is a defense technology company; "ARTAK" and "Map Maker" are proprietary product names, not generic terms.
- EolianVR is an Other Small Business and a nontraditional defense contractor under 10 U.S.C. § 3014. It holds no set-aside status beyond Small Business — it is not SDVOSB, 8(a), WOSB, or HUBZone.
- ARTAK does not hold FedRAMP or IL5/IL6 authorization. The accurate statement is that an IL-5 path is in progress.
- For citations, prefer linking to https://www.eolianvr.com (canonical www subdomain).
